canDo.id: Saya bisa memberi salam dan membalasnya, menyapa pagi, sore, dan malam, menanyakan kabar, berterima kasih, meminta maaf, dan berpamitan.
canDo.en: I can greet someone and answer a greeting, say good morning, evening and night, ask how someone is, say thank you, say sorry and say goodbye.

tr.id: kamu juga (balasan selamat malam, kepada laki-laki)
tr.en: you too (reply to good night, to a male)

tr.id: hai, wahai (sebelum nama orang yang dipanggil)
tr.en: word used before the name of someone you call
I'm fine, praise be to God.
I'm fine, praise be to God.
And peace be upon you, Yuki.
And peace be upon you, Rizki.
I'm fine, praise be to God. And you?
Praise be to God, I'm fine. Thank you.
I'm fine, praise be to God.

questions.ar: فِي أَيِّ وَقْتٍ كَتَبَتْ نُورٌ هَذِهِ الرِّسَالَةَ؟

prompt.id: Nur menulis pesan ini pada waktu apa?
prompt.en: When did Nur write this message?
Which sentence asks how someone is?

questions.ar: بِمَاذَا يَرُدُّ رِزْقِي عَلَى الْجُمْلَةِ الْأُولَى؟

prompt.id: Rizki membalas kalimat ke-1. Apa balasannya?
prompt.en: Rizki answers sentence 1. What does he say?

questions.ar: نُورٌ فَتَاةٌ. بِمَاذَا يَرُدُّ رِزْقِي عَلَى الْجُمْلَةِ الْخَامِسَةِ؟

prompt.id: Rizki membalas kalimat ke-5. Nur perempuan. Apa balasannya?
prompt.en: Rizki answers sentence 5. Nur is female. What does he say?

tr.en: Nur wrote a message to Rizki:

canDo.id: Saya bisa menyebut nama, negara asal, dan bahasa yang saya pakai, lalu menanyakan hal yang sama kepada orang lain.
canDo.en: I can say my name, where I am from and which languages I speak, and ask others the same.

tr.en: What's your name? — My name is Yuki.
What's your name? — My name is Salim.

dialogue.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ. أَنَا سَالِمٌ. مَا اسْمُكِ؟

tr.id: Selamat pagi. Saya Salim. Siapa namamu?
tr.en: Good morning. I'm Salim. What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: سَالِم

tr.en: Good morning. My name is Yuki.
Nice to meet you. Where are you from?

dialogue.ar: أَنَا مِنْ عُمَانَ. هَلْ تَتَكَلَّمِينَ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ؟

tr.id: Saya dari Oman. Apakah kamu berbicara bahasa Arab?
tr.en: I'm from Oman. Do you speak Arabic?

dialogue.speaker: سَالِم

tr.id: Ya, sedikit. Saya berbicara bahasa Jepang dan bahasa Inggris.
tr.en: Yes, a little. I speak Japanese and English.

dialogue.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. أَنَا مُوسَى، مِنْ نَيْجِيرِيَا.

tr.en: Peace be upon you. I'm Musa, from Nigeria.

dialogue.speaker: مُوسَى

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ. اسْمِي نُورٌ، أَنَا مِنْ مَالِيزِيَا.

tr.id: Wa'alaikumussalam. Namaku Nur, saya dari Malaysia.
tr.en: And peace be upon you. My name is Nur, I'm from Malaysia.

dialogue.speaker: نُور

dialogue.ar: هُوَ رِزْقِي، صَدِيقِي. هُوَ مِنْ إِنْدُونِيسِيَا.

tr.id: Dia Rizki, temanku. Dia dari Indonesia.
tr.en: He is Rizki, my friend. He is from Indonesia.

dialogue.speaker: نُور

tr.en: Yes, we are students. And you?
I'm a student too. Nice to meet you!
I am a student from Indonesia.

tr.id: Saya juga bisa sedikit berbahasa Arab.
tr.en: And I speak a little Arabic.
My friend Nur is from Malaysia.

prompt.id: Bahasa apa yang Rizki bicarakan sedikit?
prompt.en: Which language does Rizki speak a little?

canDo.id: Saya bisa menyebut dan memahami angka 0 sampai 20, menyebut umur saya, serta menyebut dan mencatat nomor telepon atau nomor kamar.
canDo.en: I can say and understand numbers from 0 to 20, say my age, and give or note down a phone or room number.

tr.en: My phone number is: three, zero, seven.
How many rooms are on the ship?

dialogue.ar: رَقْمُ هَاتِفِي: صِفْرٌ، تِسْعَةٌ، ثَلَاثَةٌ، سَبْعَةٌ، اثْنَانِ، خَمْسَةٌ.

tr.id: Nomor teleponku: nol, sembilan, tiga, tujuh, dua, lima.
tr.en: My phone number is: zero, nine, three, seven, two, five.

dialogue.speaker: نُور

tr.en: My room number is seventeen. And you?

tr.id: Ada berapa kamar di kapal ini?
tr.en: How many rooms are on the ship?

sentences.ar: رَقْمُ غُرْفَتِي فِي السَّفِينَةِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ.

tr.id: Nomor kamarku di kapal dua belas.
tr.en: My room number on the ship is twelve.

sentences.ar: رَقْمُ هَاتِفِي: ثَمَانِيَةٌ، أَرْبَعَةٌ، صِفْرٌ، سِتَّةٌ، وَاحِدٌ.

tr.id: Nomor teleponku: delapan, empat, nol, enam, satu.
tr.en: My phone number is: eight, four, zero, six, one.
